# Third-party setup

[[ app.name ]] connects to accounts you own on other platforms. These guides cover the steps **on the other platform's side** — creating apps, tokens, numbers and keys — with links back to the matching screen in [[ app.name ]].

| Platform | You need it for | Guide | In [[ app.name ]] |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Meta for Developers** | WhatsApp channel | [Meta app for WhatsApp](meta-whatsapp-cloud-api.md) | [WhatsApp](../setup/channels/whatsapp.md) |
| **Telegram** | Telegram channel, agent alerts | [Telegram BotFather](telegram-botfather.md) | [Telegram](../setup/channels/telegram.md) |
| **Twilio** | SMS channel, agent alerts | [Twilio](twilio.md) | [SMS](../setup/channels/sms.md) |
| **Gmail, Microsoft 365, Zoho, …** | Email channel | [Email providers](email-providers.md) | [Email](../setup/channels/email.md) |
| **OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, OpenRouter, …** | AI models | [AI provider API keys](ai-provider-keys.md) | [AI models](../setup/ai-models.md) |
| **Meta Business Suite** | Meta lead ads | [Meta Business Suite lead access](meta-lead-access.md) | [Meta Ads](../setup/lead-sources/meta-ads.md) |
| **Google Ads** | Google Ads lead forms | [Google Ads lead form webhook](google-ads-webhook.md) | [Google Ads](../setup/lead-sources/google-ads.md) |

!!! note "Platforms change their screens"
    Menu names on other platforms change from time to time. If a step doesn't match what you see, the **official docs** link at the end of each guide has the current version — or [contact support](../account/support.md).

!!! danger "Keep credentials private"
    Tokens, API keys and passwords give full access to those accounts. [[ app.name ]] encrypts them before storing and never shows them again. Never share them in a support ticket or email.
